Undergraduate Program
The CU Boulder College of Engineering and Applied Science is 17th among public engineering programs in the nation according to a 2024 U.S. News & World Report. Here, you'll be taught by some of the country's best faculty who are making a difference through innovation and collaboration. The interdisciplinary undergraduate program in Biomedical Engineering provides a strong foundation in basic sciences, math, engineering and biology. When coupled with extracurricular activities, like research, internships and study abroad, it prepares our students to pursue a wide variety of post-graduate opportunities in industry and healthcare.
Graduate Program
Our graduate programs here at CU Boulder are renowned for being amongst the strongest in the nation, ranked 10th overall for public graduate engineering programs according to a 2024 U.S. News & World Report. The interdisciplinary Biomedical Engineering PhD and MS programs offer robust training and research experience under the guidance of exceptional faculty in the areas of biomechanics and mechanobiology; biomedical devices; imaging and diagnostics, and therapeutics. We partner with top-ranked medical institutions (CU Anschutz), laboratories (NIST), and local tech companies to advance translational solutions for biological and medical challenges.
